description: Deterministically inspect repository targets, reviewed Tasks/contracts, actors, capabilities and the persistent UI Map, and return the application model plus a compact grounded release-contract plan. `inspect` is read-only; `write` creates .tapp artifacts without overwriting; `refresh` updates source evidence; `explore` builds/starts a detected target, runs the real-surface exploration, merges its UI Map, then refreshes the plan. Keyless; no AI unless remote AI was explicitly enabled.

androidAppId.description: Android: application id on a connected emulator/device

apkPath.description: Android: optional APK to install first

appBundleId.description: iOS: bundle id of the installed app

projectDir.description: Repo-relative project root; defaults to the MCP workspace root

target.description: Explore target selector: web target name/path, or iOS repo dir, Xcode container, .app, or bundle id

url.description: Owned web runtime URL when already running; omit during web explore to build/start the detected target

watch.description: Web explore: show the controlled browser

name: tapp_init
title: Inspect a repository: application model + release plan
